note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Mozambique: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: A resident's income is taxed on an annual scale of 10% to MZN 42,000, 15% to 168,000, 20% to 504,000, 25% to 1,512,000 and 32% above (applied to the whole income less a deduction per band); a municipal tax is also withheld (MZN 510 in Maputo for 2024).
The tax year is the calendar year; returns are filed January to April of the following year and any balance paid by the end of May (employment) or June.

sources.said: The tax year is the calendar year.
Individual tax returns must be submitted from January to April of the year following the tax year.

figures.finding: Social security is 3% from the employee and 4% from the employer on monthly pay; foreign employees covered at home may be exempted.

sources.said: The employer contributes an amount equal to 4% of monthly salary, and the employee contributes 3% of monthly salary.

figures.finding: Employers withhold income tax monthly at the legal rates (0% to 32%) and pay it by the 20th of the following month.

sources.said: Employers withhold earned income tax on a monthly basis for work carried out in Mozambique at the WHT rates approved by law, which currently vary from 0% to 32%.

figures.finding: A non-resident's earned income is withheld by the payer at a definitive flat 20% in most cases.

sources.said: For non-Mozambican residents, the earned income tax is withheld and remitted by the employer or other payer at a definitive flat rate of 20% (in the majority of the income received).

sources.title: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries: Mozambique, Individual - Taxes on personal income (reviewed 11 August 2026)
sources.said: 0 42,000 10 42,000 168,000 15 2,100 168,000 504,000 20 10,500 504,000 1,512,000 25 37,500 1,512,000 32 141,540 … For non-Mozambican residents, the earned income tax is withheld and remitted by the employer or other payer at a definitive flat rate of 20% (in the majority of the income received).

sources.said: The tax year is the calendar year. … Individual tax returns must be submitted from January to April of the year following the tax year. … Employers withhold earned income tax on a monthly basis for work carried out in Mozambique at the WHT rates approved by law, which currently vary from 0% to 32%.

sources.title: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries: Mozambique, Individual - Other taxes (reviewed 11 August 2026)
sources.said: The employer contributes an amount equal to 4% of monthly salary, and the employee contributes 3% of monthly salary. … The standard rate is 16%.
